0.content:
# 🧪 My Bindplane lab — proof of work
Pick **your project name** in the **Me** selector above. Every tick below is earned from your data actually arriving in Dynatrace, so it proves your pipeline works, not just that you configured it.

1.title: My milestones
1.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
| summarize first_ts = min(timestamp), by: { host.name }
| fields host.name, milestone = "01 Pipeline live", first_ts
| append [
  timeseries v = avg(otelcol_process_memory_rss), by: { host.name }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(isNotNull(v[]), iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields host.name, milestone = "02 Cumulative to delta", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| append [
  timeseries v = sum(log.exposed_bch_credentials.count), by: { host.name, bch_access_key_id }, interval: 1m
  | filter isNotNull(bch_access_key_id) and not startsWith(bch_access_key_id, "BCHK")
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(v[] > 0, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields host.name, milestone = "09 Signal to metric", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| lookup [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
  | summarize n = count(), by: { host.name, project }
  | sort n desc
  | summarize project = takeFirst(project), by: { host.name }
], sourceField: host.name, lookupField: host.name, prefix: "m_"
| filter isNotNull(m_project)
| fields project = m_project, milestone, first_ts
| filter project == $Me
| append [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and project == $Me and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
  | parse content, "LD 'BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' NSPACE:bch_ak SPACE 'BCH_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' NSPACE:bch_sk"
  | fieldsAdd bch_sk = replaceString(bch_sk, "\"", "")
  | summarize {
      m03 = min(if(true, timestamp)),
      m04 = min(if(appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action), timestamp)),
      m05 = min(if(appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action) and (isNull(content) or content == ""), timestamp)),
      m07 = min(if(log.file.name == "audit.log" and isNotNull(bch_ak) and not startsWith(bch_ak, "BCHK") and stringLength(bch_ak) >= 64 and stringLength(bch_sk) >= 64, timestamp)),
      m08 = min(if(isNotNull(bch_access_key_id) and not startsWith(bch_access_key_id, "BCHK"), timestamp)),
      m10 = min(if(log.file.name == "syslog" and isNotNull(syslog.severity), timestamp))
    }, by: { project }
  | fieldsAdd ev = array(
      record(milestone = "03 Project tagged", first_ts = m03),
      record(milestone = "04 Parse CSV", first_ts = m04),
      record(milestone = "05 Delete body.message", first_ts = m05),
      record(milestone = "07 Masking", first_ts = m07),
      record(milestone = "08 Parse regex", first_ts = m08),
      record(milestone = "10 OpenPipeline syslog", first_ts = m10))
  | expand ev
  | fields project, milestone = ev[milestone], first_ts = ev[first_ts]
  | filter isNotNull(first_ts)
]
| append [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and project == $Me and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
  | makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(total[] >= 30 and allow[] / total[] < 0.8, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields project, milestone = "06 Sampling", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| summarize first_ts = min(first_ts), by: { project, milestone }
| summarize c = countDistinct(milestone)
| fields v = concat(toString(c), " / 10")

| summarize first_ts = min(first_ts), by: { project, milestone }
| filter not in(project, array($Exclude))
| summarize {
    score = countDistinct(milestone),
    started = min(first_ts),
    last = max(first_ts),
    last_precise = max(if(in(milestone, array("01 Pipeline live", "03 Project tagged", "04 Parse CSV", "05 Delete body.message", "07 Masking", "08 Parse regex", "10 OpenPipeline syslog")), first_ts)),
    c01 = min(if(milestone == "01 Pipeline live", first_ts)),
    c02 = min(if(milestone == "02 Cumulative to delta", first_ts)),
    c03 = min(if(milestone == "03 Project tagged", first_ts)),

    c05 = min(if(milestone == "05 Delete body.message", first_ts)),
    c06 = min(if(milestone == "06 Sampling", first_ts)),

| summarize {

| expand rows
| summarize { ahead = countIf(rows[s] > ms or (rows[s] == ms and rows[l] < ml)), n = takeAny(n) }

4.title: Credentials I exposed (hashed)

5.title: ✅ My checklist
5.query:
data
  record(milestone = "01 Pipeline live", how_it_is_verified = "First lab log (PAN-OS syslog or syslog/audit.log/fail2ban.log file) from your collector host"),
  record(milestone = "02 Cumulative to delta", how_it_is_verified = "Collector self-metrics reach Dynatrace (they are rejected until delta temporality)"),
  record(milestone = "03 Project tagged", how_it_is_verified = "First lab log carrying your project attribute"),
  record(milestone = "04 Parse CSV", how_it_is_verified = "PAN-OS records arrive with named pan.* fields"),
  record(milestone = "05 Delete body.message", how_it_is_verified = "Parsed PAN-OS records arrive without the raw CSV"),
  record(milestone = "06 Sampling", how_it_is_verified = "Allow share of parsed traffic drops below 80% (baseline ~93%)"),
  record(milestone = "07 Masking", how_it_is_verified = "BCH access key and secret arrive hashed (64+ hex chars), never raw"),
  record(milestone = "08 Parse regex", how_it_is_verified = "bch_access_key_id attribute extracted from the hashed value"),
  record(milestone = "09 Signal to metric", how_it_is_verified = "log.exposed_bch_credentials.count arrives with a hashed key dimension"),
  record(milestone = "10 OpenPipeline syslog", how_it_is_verified = "Host syslog records (file source) arrive with syslog.* fields from the OpenPipeline Syslog bundle")
| lookup [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
  | summarize first_ts = min(timestamp), by: { host.name }
  | fields host.name, milestone = "01 Pipeline live", first_ts
  | append [
    timeseries v = avg(otelcol_process_memory_rss), by: { host.name }, interval: 1m
    | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(isNotNull(v[]), iIndex()))))
    | filter isNotNull(idx)
    | fields host.name, milestone = "02 Cumulative to delta", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
  ]
  | append [
    timeseries v = sum(log.exposed_bch_credentials.count), by: { host.name, bch_access_key_id }, interval: 1m
    | filter isNotNull(bch_access_key_id) and not startsWith(bch_access_key_id, "BCHK")
    | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(v[] > 0, iIndex()))))
    | filter isNotNull(idx)
    | fields host.name, milestone = "09 Signal to metric", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
  ]
  | lookup [
    fetch logs
    | filter isNotNull(project) and isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
    | summarize n = count(), by: { host.name, project }
    | sort n desc
    | summarize project = takeFirst(project), by: { host.name }
  ], sourceField: host.name, lookupField: host.name, prefix: "m_"
  | filter isNotNull(m_project)
  | fields project = m_project, milestone, first_ts
  | filter project == $Me
  | append [
    fetch logs
    | filter isNotNull(project) and project == $Me and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
    | parse content, "LD 'BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' NSPACE:bch_ak SPACE 'BCH_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' NSPACE:bch_sk"
    | fieldsAdd bch_sk = replaceString(bch_sk, "\"", "")
    | summarize {
        m03 = min(if(true, timestamp)),
        m04 = min(if(appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action), timestamp)),
        m05 = min(if(appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action) and (isNull(content) or content == ""), timestamp)),
        m07 = min(if(log.file.name == "audit.log" and isNotNull(bch_ak) and not startsWith(bch_ak, "BCHK") and stringLength(bch_ak) >= 64 and stringLength(bch_sk) >= 64, timestamp)),
        m08 = min(if(isNotNull(bch_access_key_id) and not startsWith(bch_access_key_id, "BCHK"), timestamp)),
        m10 = min(if(log.file.name == "syslog" and isNotNull(syslog.severity), timestamp))
      }, by: { project }
    | fieldsAdd ev = array(
        record(milestone = "03 Project tagged", first_ts = m03),
        record(milestone = "04 Parse CSV", first_ts = m04),
        record(milestone = "05 Delete body.message", first_ts = m05),
        record(milestone = "07 Masking", first_ts = m07),
        record(milestone = "08 Parse regex", first_ts = m08),
        record(milestone = "10 OpenPipeline syslog", first_ts = m10))
    | expand ev
    | fields project, milestone = ev[milestone], first_ts = ev[first_ts]
    | filter isNotNull(first_ts)
  ]
  | append [
    fetch logs
    | filter isNotNull(project) and project == $Me and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
    | makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
    | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(total[] >= 30 and allow[] / total[] < 0.8, iIndex()))))
    | filter isNotNull(idx)
    | fields project, milestone = "06 Sampling", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
  ]
  | summarize first_ts = min(first_ts), by: { project, milestone }
], sourceField: milestone, lookupField: milestone, prefix: "e_"
| fieldsAdd status = if(isNull(e_first_ts), "⬜ Not yet", else: "✅ Done")
| fields milestone, status, achieved_at = e_first_ts, how_it_is_verified

7.title: My parsed firewall records (latest 20)
7.query:
fetch logs
| filter project == $Me and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 20
| fieldsAdd raw_csv = if(isNull(content) or content == "", "removed ✅", else: "still present")
| fields timestamp, pan.action, pan.app, pan.src_ip, pan.dst_ip, pan.dst_port, pan.bytes, pan.session_end_reason, raw_csv

9.title: My firewall traffic per minute — allow vs everything else
9.query:
fetch logs
| filter project == $Me and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
| makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), deny_drop_reset = countIf(pan.action != "allow") }, interval: 1m

10.title: My allow share (%) — drops when sampling kicks in
10.query:
fetch logs
| filter project == $Me and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
| makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd allow_share_pct = 100 * allow[] / total[]
| fields timeframe, interval, allow_share_pct

12.title: Credential records — raw vs hashed per minute
12.query:
fetch logs
| filter project == $Me and log.file.name == "audit.log" and contains(content, "BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=")
| parse content, "LD 'BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' NSPACE:bch_ak SPACE 'BCH_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' NSPACE:bch_sk"
| fieldsAdd bch_sk = replaceString(bch_sk, "\"", "")
| fieldsAdd state = if(startsWith(bch_ak, "BCHK"), "raw", else: if(stringLength(bch_ak) >= 64 and stringLength(bch_sk) >= 64, "hashed", else: "partial"))
| makeTimeseries { raw = countIf(state == "raw"), hashed = countIf(state == "hashed"), partial = countIf(state == "partial") }, interval: 1m

14.title: My latest credential records

fetch logs
| filter project == $Me and log.file.name == "audit.log" and contains(content, "BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=")
| parse content, "LD 'BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' NSPACE:bch_ak SPACE 'BCH_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' NSPACE:bch_sk"
| fieldsAdd bch_sk = replaceString(bch_sk, "\"", "")
| fieldsAdd state = if(startsWith(bch_ak, "BCHK"), "raw", else: if(stringLength(bch_ak) >= 64 and stringLength(bch_sk) >= 64, "hashed", else: "partial"))
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 10
| fields timestamp, state, content

17.title: My collector memory (self-telemetry)
